basic_details.scholarship_name: Universiti Teknologi Malaysia (UTM) National Postgraduate Research Scholarship
basic_details.offering_entity: Universiti Teknologi Malaysia (UTM) & Malaysian Ministry of Higher Education
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Universiti Teknologi Malaysia Main Campus (Skudai, Johor Bahru) & Kuala Lumpur Campus (Jalan Sultan Yahya Petra, KL, Malaysia)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Faculty of Computing (FC) & Faculty of Electrical Engineering (FKE): Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Cloud Computing, Data Science, and Robotics.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~80 to 120 graduate research scholarships (UTM Young Scholars & Graduate Research Assistantships) awarded annually
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international merit competition; Pakistani researchers in computing and engineering secure ~10 to 16 awards annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 2 years for Master's; up to 3 to 4 years for PhD, subject to satisfactory semester research progress evaluations
basic_details.monthly_stipend_amount: MYR 1,800 to MYR 2,800 / month living stipend (~PKR 115,000 - 182,000 / month)

nationality_requirements: Open to international students of all nationalities (Pakistan fully eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Applicants must generally be under 35 years old at the time of application.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: A recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) with minimum CGPA 3.30 / 4.00 for Master's; recognized MS/MPhil (18 years education) with minimum CGPA 3.50 / 4.00 for PhD from an HEC-recognized university in Pakistan.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum grade equivalent of Grade B+ or CGPA 3.30 / 4.00.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Rigorous undergraduate preparation in computer science, software engineering, or electrical engineering.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduating seniors or Master's students in their final semester can apply conditionally with expected graduation transcripts.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Prior software development projects, hackathon achievements, or published research papers are advantageous.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.0, TOEFL iBT minimum 79, or institutional English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate from an accredited Pakistani university.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; postgraduate research and coursework are conducted 100% in English.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Applicants must identify a prospective supervisor at UTM Faculty of Computing and obtain preliminary consent.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold another full national or university scholarship simultaneously.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition fee and academic examination fee waiver at Universiti Teknologi Malaysia covered by the scholarship or research grant.

admission_application_fee.details: UTM international postgraduate application fee (~MYR 200 / USD 50) paid online via the portal.

accommodation.details: On-campus student residential colleges (Kolej Mahallah) at UTM Skudai or UTM KL; monthly rent is paid from the monthly living allowance.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly tax-free living stipend: MYR 1,800 to MYR 2,300 per month for Master's; MYR 2,300 to MYR 2,800 per month for PhD (~PKR 115,000 - 182,000 / month; MYR 21,600 - 33,600 / year).

airfare.details: International airfare to Malaysia arranged by student; living allowance easily accommodates local savings.

visa_fee.details: EMGS visa approval letter (VAL) and Student Pass fees (~MYR 2,000 total) covered from stipend or research grant.

health_insurance.details: Mandatory Malaysian student health and hospitalization insurance included within the EMGS Student Pass package.

food_allowance.details: Covered via the monthly living stipend of MYR 1,800 - 2,800; campus cafeterias provide affordable halal meals.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full access to UTM Library, engineering laboratories, GPU clusters, and software development platforms.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Departmental research funding available through supervisor's research grants for publishing in indexed journals.
research_funding_conference_grant.amount: Up to MYR 3,500 for conference attendance

travel_transit_allowance.details: Free UTM campus shuttle bus service operating across all academic zones and student hostels.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single leading engineering and technological institution: Universiti Teknologi Malaysia (UTM).
participating_institutions: Universiti Teknologi Malaysia (Main Campus Skudai, Johor & KL Campus, Malaysia)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Ranked #181 globally in QS World University Rankings, #2 in Malaysia for Engineering & Technology, and top 100 globally in Computer Science & Information Systems.
available_majors: MPhil / PhD in Computer Science (Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning)
MPhil / PhD in Cybersecurity and Information Assurance
MPhil / PhD in Data Science and Business Analytics
MPhil / PhD in Electrical Engineering and Robotics
MPhil / PhD in Telecommunications and IoT
university_and_program_options.program_duration: 2 years for MPhil; 3 to 4 years for PhD
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's degree (minimum CGPA 3.3/4.0) for Master's; Master's degree (minimum CGPA 3.5/4.0) for PhD, supervisor consent, research proposal, two recommendation letters, and English proficiency.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: UTM Faculty of Computing AI and Cybersecurity labs have high demand; reaching out to supervisors with active MOHE/CREST research grants is the primary path to guaranteed funding.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Browse the UTM Faculty of Computing directory (computing.utm.my), identify matching research groups in AI/software, and email prospective professors attaching your CV and a 2-page research proposal before applying on the UTM Smart portal.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Identify prospective supervisor on UTM portal, secure consent, register an applicant account on UTM Smart, submit degree application, and apply for the research assistantship / scholarship.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Explore faculty research profiles on UTM Faculty of Computing portal (https://computing.utm.my/).
Step 2: Email prospective supervisor with academic transcripts, CV, and a 2-page research proposal to secure consent.
Step 3: Register and apply online for postgraduate admission on the UTM Smart portal (https://admission.utm.my/).
Step 4: Upload attested transcripts, degrees, research proposal, CV, and reference letters.
Step 5: Apply for Graduate Research Assistantship (GRA) scheme through the supervisor's grant.
Step 6: Attend faculty technical interview via Zoom if required.
Step 7: Receive official offer letter and fellowship award, then initiate the EMGS visa approval letter (VAL) process.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Supervisor Track: Admission and funding are processed jointly through the supervising faculty.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted on institutional letterhead signed by former academic professors or research supervisors.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of academic purpose detailing research accomplishments, technical capabilities, and postgraduate research vision.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Structured 2 to 4-page research proposal detailing background, problem statement, research methodology, and expected timeline.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Detailed academic CV highlighting technical projects, publications, programming proficiencies, and awards.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: 30-minute technical interview via Zoom conducted by prospective supervisor and faculty panel.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic (min 6.0), TOEFL iBT (min 79), or institutional English MOI letter accepted; GRE not required.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Degrees and transcripts attested by HEC and MOFA Pakistan; Matric/Inter by IBCC.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translation required for all official documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online submission via UTM Smart admissions portal.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Official Academic Transcripts and Degree Certificates
required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete transcripts for 16-year Bachelor's (for MSc) or 18-year Master's (for PhD) with minimum CGPA 3.3/4.0.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested copies from HEC and MOFA Pakistan.

required_documents_checklist.specification: 2 to 4-page structured proposal outlining problem statement, methodology, and timeline.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must be aligned with UTM supervisor's funded research area.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Letter or email confirmation from an eligible UTM professor agreeing to supervise.
Confidential academic evaluations from previous professors.
IELTS Academic (min 6.0), TOEFL iBT (min 79), or institutional English MOI letter.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: MOI letter signed by university registrar.

required_documents_checklist.specification: High-resolution color scan of all passport pages valid for at least 2 years.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Pakistani passport must have validity through late 2028.

important_dates_timeline.application_open_date: Open year-round (Semester 1 intake opens March / Semester 2 opens September)
important_dates_timeline.application_deadline: June 30 (for October intake) / November 30 (for March intake)
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Admissions operate on two semester intakes: Semester 1 (October) and Semester 2 (March). Applying 3-4 months in advance is recommended.

selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 35% (Quality of research proposal, technical project portfolio, and supervisor match)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Clarity of purpose and postgraduate research vision)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 0% (Interview performance factored directly into supervisor endorsement)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: UTM School of Graduate Studies and Faculty of Computing Postgraduate Board.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-phase evaluation: supervisor nomination followed by faculty board academic review.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~800 to 1,200 international applicants for UTM postgraduate programs
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~80 to 120 graduate research scholarships awarded annually
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~10% to 15% among candidates with supervisor consent
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: CGPA 3.45+ / 4.00 from top Pakistani engineering institutions (NUST, FAST, GIKI, UET, NED)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates of accredited computing and engineering faculties with solid programming foundations and practical capstone projects.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of Pakistani computer science, software engineering, and electrical engineering faculties.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Bangladesh, China, Iran, Nigeria, Indonesia, India, Yemen.

fake_websites_and_scams: Beware of educational agents claiming to provide 'guaranteed UTM admissions or scholarship awards'.
Applications are handled exclusively via the official UTM Smart portal (https://admission.utm.my/).
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: UTM application fee is MYR 200 paid directly on the portal; never transfer funds to personal bank accounts.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Universiti Teknologi Malaysia does not work with third-party agents for research degree admissions.
hidden_costs_breakdown: EMGS visa approval letter (VAL) and medical fee: ~MYR 2,000 (~PKR 130,000).
Initial pocket money before first stipend transfer: ~MYR 1,500 (~PKR 98,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: You can apply without a supervisor. Reality: Research MPhil and PhD applications at UTM require prior engagement and consent from a qualified supervisor.
Myth: UTM only focuses on engineering. Reality: UTM Faculty of Computing is one of the premier computer science and cybersecurity hubs in Southeast Asia.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial websites state IELTS 6.5 is mandatory; UTM requires IELTS 6.0 or institutional English MOI letter for computing degrees.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain satisfactory research progress (Progress Report Grade Satisfactory) each semester.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical research attendance in the faculty research lab at UTM Skudai or UTM KL.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semi-annual progress reports evaluated by the Faculty Supervisory Committee.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: GRA recipients may be assigned teaching assistantship or grading duties (up to 6 hours/week) within the faculty.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: No return obligation; graduates are free to pursue postdocs or careers in Malaysia or worldwide.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Publication milestone obligation: must publish at least 1-2 papers in indexed journals prior to thesis submission.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Funding cancelled if the candidate fails progress evaluations twice or withdraws without approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Non-transferable to other universities; tied specifically to Universiti Teknologi Malaysia.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Requires approval from both current and prospective supervisors and the Faculty Postgraduate Committee.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Scholarship is granted for standard duration (2 years for Master's; 3-4 years for PhD).
